title: Choose a starting point
subtitle: The signed-in home screen offers caption rating and image-based generation.

title: Rate a caption
subtitle: Users evaluate image-caption pairs with voting controls and round progress.

title: Start a generation request
subtitle: An image is selected and ready to submit for caption generation.

title: Follow generation progress
subtitle: The interface distinguishes upload preparation, image registration, and caption generation.

title: Review generated captions
subtitle: The personal caption viewer presents an image and lets users move between captions.

title: Explore highlights
subtitle: A highlights view presents ranked image-caption pairs with display-count controls.

title: Find a humor flavor
subtitle: The searchable library provides access to humor-flavor configurations.

title: Inspect the prompt chain
subtitle: Ordered steps expose prompts, model selections, and input/output types.

title: Choose a test set
subtitle: A flavor can be tested against an existing image set.

title: Monitor a batch run
subtitle: Per-image states and overall counts make batch progress visible.

title: Inspect caption outputs
subtitle: A caption gallery allows generated examples to be reviewed. This screen shows a different image from the preceding test-set selection.

title: Inspect caption records
subtitle: Search, filters, and expanded records expose caption metadata and associated identifiers.

title: Inspect image context
subtitle: An expanded image record displays its description and additional context.

title: Analyze recurring openers
subtitle: A chart compares vote distributions for recurring caption-opening phrases.

title: Compare caption popularity
subtitle: Ranked captions show net scores and underlying upvote/downvote counts.

title: Inspect flavor-step configuration
subtitle: Expanded step details expose model metadata, prompts, and references to earlier outputs.
